name: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk
summary: PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk functions as a holding entity, primarily involved in the extraction of gold, the processing of associated minerals, and other ancillary business operations. This company was formerly recognized as PT Pani Bersama Jaya. Established in 2015, its principal office is situated in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk operates as a direct subsidiary of PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk.
